diagnosis: The online-checkpoint gate proved that complete-model incumbents can descend many times without changing the final endpoint. The remaining limitation is search depth and route novelty: the corrected MV-HGS-SP finishes in roughly one to two minutes on the illustration case, whereas the Chen-2025 comparison reports minute-scale searches with a 12.52-minute average for its main method. More scoring of the same 5000-iteration search is therefore insufficient.
candidate: Two-stage same-view exact-elite migration. Stage 1 reproduces the protected 5000-iteration archive-route-reuse algorithm and its 5-second base-pool MIP. Stage 2 runs 20000 additional HGS iterations per view, warm-started only by that view's eight complete-model elites, while performing ten fixed online exact checkpoints. A second 5-second MIP recombines the union of both stages and all views. The returned solution is the best independently feasible result among the protected stage-1 output, both-stage single-view elites, and the expanded recombination.

failure_rule: Reject if any invariant fails, fewer than three tasks improve over the protected stage-1 method, either strong electric view is beaten strictly on fewer than three tasks, or fewer than five main trajectories meet the genuine complete-incumbent shape gate. Do not alter depth, checkpoints, seeds, cases, or thresholds after results.
claim_boundary: Development only. Passing authorizes one separately frozen confirmation and then a complete corrected E2 rerun; it is not itself paper evidence.
